clues: This city grew around a small island in a wide, winding river that flows west to the sea. A steep hill rises to its north.
Winters here are cool and grey, and soft rain can fall in any month of the year. Summers are warm but seldom hot, and the sky is often grey.
Traders came by river and settled that island more than 2,000 years ago. Much later, a great stone church with two tall towers was begun on the same island.
A lacy iron tower rose for a fair in 1889, built to be torn down when the fair's years ran out. People loved it so much it stayed, and now it is the sign of the city.
The president of France lives and works in a palace in this city, and the laws of the land are made here too. This city is the capital of France.
